questions.prompt: Solve the simultaneous equations 2x + 3y = 12 and x + y = 5.

provenance.publisher: National Council for Curriculum and Assessment, Ghana
provenance.title: Secondary Education Curriculum — Core Mathematics

questions.workedSolution: From the second equation, x = 5 − y. Substituting into the first: 2(5 − y) + 3y = 12, so 10 − 2y + 3y = 12, giving y = 2. Then x = 5 − 2 = 3. Check: 2(3) + 3(2) = 6 + 6 = 12, as required. Answer: x = 3 and y = 2.

questions.prompt: Make x the subject of the formula y = (3x − 2)/(x + 5).

provenance.publisher: National Council for Curriculum and Assessment, Ghana
provenance.title: Secondary Education Curriculum — Core Mathematics

questions.workedSolution: Multiply both sides by (x + 5): y(x + 5) = 3x − 2, so xy + 5y = 3x − 2. Collect the terms in x: xy − 3x = −2 − 5y, so x(y − 3) = −(5y + 2). Dividing both sides by (y − 3) gives x = −(5y + 2)/(y − 3), which simplifies to x = (5y + 2)/(3 − y). Answer: x = (5y + 2)/(3 − y).

questions.prompt: Solve the equation x² + 4x − 5 = 0 by completing the square.

provenance.publisher: National Council for Curriculum and Assessment, Ghana
provenance.title: Secondary Education Curriculum — Core Mathematics

questions.workedSolution: Complete the square: x² + 4x − 5 = (x + 2)² − 4 − 5 = (x + 2)² − 9 = 0. So (x + 2)² = 9, giving x + 2 = ±3. Hence x = 3 − 2 = 1 or x = −3 − 2 = −5. Check by factorising: (x − 1)(x + 5) = 0 gives the same roots. Answer: x = 1 or x = −5.

questions.prompt: Find the set of values of k for which the equation x² + 4x + k = 0 has real roots.

provenance.publisher: National Council for Curriculum and Assessment, Ghana
provenance.title: Secondary Education Curriculum — Core Mathematics

questions.workedSolution: Real roots require the discriminant to be non-negative: b² − 4ac ≥ 0. Here a = 1 and b = 4, so 4² − 4(1)(k) ≥ 0, giving 16 − 4k ≥ 0, hence 4k ≤ 16 and k ≤ 4. Answer: k ≤ 4.

questions.prompt: O is the centre of a circle; A, B and C are points on its circumference with C on the major arc AB. If angle AOB = 130°, calculate angle ACB.

questions.prompt: From the top of a cliff 40 m high, the angle of depression of a boat at sea is 30°. Calculate the distance of the boat from the foot of the cliff, leaving your answer in surd form.

questions.prompt: A box contains 3 green balls and 5 yellow balls. Two balls are picked at random, one after the other, without replacement. Find the probability that they are of different colours.

provenance.publisher: National Council for Curriculum and Assessment, Ghana

questions.workedSolution: P(green then yellow) = (3/8) × (5/7) = 15/56, and P(yellow then green) = (5/8) × (3/7) = 15/56. The two cases are mutually exclusive, so add them: 15/56 + 15/56 = 30/56 = 15/28. Answer: 15/28.
